title: Sword Spider's Haste (Condition)
html:
This article is about content that is inaccessible through normal gameplay. It can still be accessed via in-game exploits or third party tools.

Sword Spider's Haste

  • Affected entity has a +2 bonus to  Armour Class,  Advantage on Dexterity  Saving Throws, its  Movement Speed is doubled, and it can take one additional  Action per turn.

Properties

UID: SPIDER_SWORD_HASTE

 Stack ID: HASTE

 Status groups: SG_Surface, SG_Condition

 Loses duration: start of turn

 Stack priority: 10

Honour mode

  • A Hastened creature can not use  Extra Attack with its additional action.
  • Applying  Slowed to a Hastened creature ends this condition, and prevents it from being reapplied as long as the creature is Slowed.[See Notes]

Notes

  • This condition appears in commented out code to initialise the goblin siege on the Emerald Grove. It would have been applied to two  Sword Spiders at the beginning of the battle.
  • The in-game description says it doubles movement speed, but it actually increases it by 12 m (40 ft).
  • Unlike the regular  Hastened condition, this condition does not inflict the  Lethargic debuff when it ends.
  •  Terazul grants a similar condition,  The Terazul Jitters, which stacks with this condition.
  • In honour mode only, Slowed and similar conditions end Sword Spider's Haste. This is because for honour mode specifically, these conditions are assigned the HASTE stack ID and a higher stack priority than Sword Spider's Haste.

Conditions with the same stack ID

Conditions with the stack ID HASTE, only one of these can be applied at the same time:
Condition Effects
Absorbed Essence: Illasera
  •  Sarevok is permanently  Hastened and can't be  Paralysed,  Restrained, or have his movement speed reduced in any way.
Black HoleHHonour
  • The black hole pulls nearby creatures and deals 3d10+4⁠⁠Force damage. The nearby area is Difficult Terrain and can  Slow creatures within it.[See: Bugs]

Hastened
  • Creature has a +2 bonus to  Armour Class,  Advantage on Dexterity  Saving Throws, its  Movement Speed increases by 9 m (30 ft),[See: Bugs] and it can take one additional  Action per turn.
  • When the condition ends, the creature becomes  Lethargic.
MindbrokenHHonour
  • Affected entity is  Slowed by the Netherbrain's psyche-shattering might.
Mud-DrenchedHHonour
  • Thick mud halves your  Movement Speed, and reduces your  Armour Class and Dexterity  Saving Throws by 2.
SlowedHHonour
  • Affected entity's  Movement Speed is halved, and its  Armour Class and Dexterity  Saving Throws are reduced by 2.
  • The entity can't take  Reactions or make more than 1 attack per turn,[See: Bugs] and can only take either an  Action or a  Bonus Action.
  • Spells cast might be delayed for 1 turn.[See: Bugs]

  • The entity can't take  Reactions or make more than 1 attack per turn,[See: Bugs] and can only take either an  Action or a  Bonus Action.
  • Spells cast might be delayed for 1 turn.[See: Bugs]
